summary.text: Matt Loesby is the Libertarian Party nominee for U.S. Senate in Idaho. A software engineer and video game developer, he ran as the Libertarian candidate for Idaho's 1st Congressional District in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Loesby was born in Glenwood Springs, Colorado, and says he grew up in a suburb south of Denver.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Chapman University in 2010, then stayed in the state where he attended college for a job in video game development until 2018, according to his campaign website.
After a brief stay in North Carolina for work, he bought a house in Idaho's Treasure Valley in 2020.

He works as a software engineer, described himself in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey as a video game developer and software engineer, and says he does administrative work and activism for the Libertarian Party of Idaho.
Loesby was the Libertarian candidate for Idaho's 1st Congressional District in 2024, receiving 9,594 votes (2.1%) in a race won by Rep. Russ Fulcher.
He advanced unopposed from the May 19, 2026, Libertarian primary for U.S. Senate with 855 votes.
